tool: experiments/rebuild-exp1/kit/shape.mjs (identical scratch copy ../rebuild-exp1/kit; acorn from its node_modules)

definitions.codeLines: lines holding at least one non-whitespace character outside a comment (a line with code + trailing comment counts as code)
definitions.commentLines: lines holding comment text and no code
definitions.functions: every FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression and ArrowFunctionExpression (callbacks and one-line arrows included); class methods would count too
definitions.functionLines: spanLines = last line - first line + 1 of the function node; codeLines = code lines (as above) inside that span, including nested functions
definitions.maxNesting: ESLint max-depth: +1 entering if / switch / try / for / for-in / for-of / while / do-while / with; an `else if` does not add a level; each function starts again at 0 (nested functions measured separately)
definitions.cyclomatic: ESLint `complexity` style: 1 per function + 1 for each if (incl. else-if), ?: , && , || , ?? (anywhere, not only inside conditions, since each short-circuits), for, for-in, for-of, while, do-while, catch, case with a test (not default), logical assignment (&&= ||= ??=), and default value (AssignmentPattern). Optional chaining (?.) is NOT counted; it is reported separately as optionalChains. Module-level code is its own unit "<module>" with base 1. total = sum over all units.
definitions.cyclomaticConditionsOnly: same as cyclomatic, except && / || / ?? are counted only when they sit inside the test of an if, ?:, while, do-while or for (classic McCabe "boolean operators in conditions")
definitions.regexLiterals: regular-expression literals /.../ (new RegExp(...) calls reported separately as regexConstructors)
definitions.topLevelDeclarations: top-level function / class declarations and variable declarators (exported or not); imports counted separately
